summary: Replaces immediately executing credential-embedded migration code with a dependency-free CLI whose default and offline planning paths perform no account requests.
Adds complete paginated definition/entry reads, variable-bound cursors, bounded read retries, API-version checks and layered HTTP/GraphQL/mutation error handling without credential dumps.
Builds deterministic immutable plans that expose schema/value conflicts, unsupported ownership/capabilities and reference mappings instead of silently dropping fields or overwriting existing entries.
Explicit apply re-exports both stores, rejects stale or forged plans and all conflicts, creates sequentially without mutation retries and journals confirmed receipts with partial-failure recovery.
Adds synthetic fixtures, 42 local tests including real loopback transport and offline child-process verification, plus nine detailed integration/CRUD upskilling documents.

checks.command: node --test test/migration.test.js; three node --check gates; staged source/docs token-literal scan
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; no third-party dependencies; controlled API clients, real temporary files, child processes and loopback HTTP only

testResults.embeddedTokenScan: No Shopify token literals in staged source/docs/JSON
testResults.transport: Controlled fetch boundaries plus one real loopback HTTP server; no live Shopify account requests or mutations
checks: Offline CLI and import have no network side effects
Deterministic plans validate source and target snapshots
Paged reads, bounded retries, GraphQL/userErrors and unknown mutation outcomes
Stale/forged plans and conflicts stop before mutation
Partial create and journal failures preserve receipts and stop later work
Exclusive output files and local journal replacement
Source object immutability and explicit reference-field conflicts

limits: Original embedded credentials must be revoked and replaced by the account owner; removing source literals does not revoke them or erase historical/backup copies. No original token was used.
No live Shopify account calls or mutations were performed; API 2026-07 documentation was reviewed but live scopes and store-specific acceptance remain unverified.
Creates only; updates, deletes, references, app-owned or unsupported-capability migrations and a full store backup are not implemented.
Exports/preflight are not atomic with concurrent remote writes; journals do not guarantee power-loss durability or remote rollback.
Theme assets and Storybook configuration are incomplete retained remnants, not a verified frontend build.
